name: Priya Raman

five_sec.what_is_it: An AI meal-planning app for families
five_sec.who_for: Parents who want dinner decisions automated
five_sec.trust_why: Polished, '90,000+ families' social proof, but the primary CTA is 'Letter from the CEO', which is an odd first action
five_sec.next_step: Scroll to see how it works
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's an app mockup; nothing suggests shipping

full_page.what_stopped_me: Pricing is incoherent: the meal page FAQ says a free 1-month trial and prices in the app; the pricing page meters 'messages' at $25 or $100 a month. The hero mockup shows sesame ground beef and pancakes; nothing about vegetarian or eggs
full_page.whats_missing: A diet filter statement (vegetarian, egg-free); one consistent price

OL.quote: The primary CTA is 'Letter from the CEO,' and pricing is metered by messages. That's a usage-anxiety model for something I'd use daily.

five_sec.what_is_it: A weekly dinner planner where the family votes by text and the list goes to Instacart or Walmart
five_sec.trust_why: No pop-up, no countdown, and it states what it doesn't do ('We don't deliver food') above the fold
five_sec.delivers_food_why: The explicit 'We don't deliver food' line

full_page.what_stopped_me: The page respects me: clear Free vs Family table, honest footnote on the store comparison. But the sample week is chicken tenders, tacos, meatballs; nothing vegetarian shown, and 'vegetarian' is just a word in a FAQ with no answer on eggs. Also the sign-up consent bundles a weekly marketing email ('the occasional kitchen pick') with the Terms
full_page.whats_missing: A lacto-vegetarian (egg-free) setting stated before sign-up; a vegetarian sample week; how the kid profile makes one component plain

DD.quote: No pop-ups, and 'We don't deliver food' above the fold. Refreshing. But the sample week is chicken, tacos, meatballs; show me an egg-free vegetarian week.

five_sec.what_is_it: Recipe manager with planning and grocery lists
five_sec.who_for: Home cooks with their own recipe collections
five_sec.trust_why: Ratings and 'no card required' up front
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Store badges and the tagline describe an app

full_page.what_stopped_me: The pricing page is genuinely clear ('No surprise renewals'), then a countdown timer to '50% OFF'. And it's bring-your-own-recipes, which doesn't solve 'will I actually cook without the box'
full_page.whats_missing: Planning help, not just storage; a kid-plain option

PTE.quote: The pricing page is a model of clarity, then a countdown timer to '50% OFF.' Pick a lane.

five_sec.what_is_it: Meal kit delivery behind a gamified offer modal
five_sec.trust_why: 'Open A Box To Reveal Your Offer!' is a spin-to-win pattern
five_sec.next_step: Continue Without Offer, then scan the plans

full_page.what_stopped_me: Same problem as Green Chef with a louder page: the vegetarian dishes include 'Honey Miso Broccoli Donburi… & Fried Eggs' and shakshuka. Price only after a zip code

HF.quote: 'Open a box to reveal your offer' is spin-to-win with a lime logo. And the veggie menu has fried eggs on the donburi.

five_sec.delivers_food_why: Lifestyle video hero doesn't say kit or recipes until 'How It Works'

full_page.what_stopped_me: Fifteen plans, but I need two at once (vegetarian and kid). 'Plant Based' would be vegan, not lacto. And 'LIMITED TIME' with an email gate before I've seen a price
full_page.whats_missing: Combined filters; price on the page

EM.quote: Fifteen plans but I need two at once, vegetarian and kid. And 'LIMITED TIME' plus an email gate before I've seen a price.

dd_offer.why: Free vs Family is laid out in a table, and it says they email 3 days before Family ends
dd_offer.expect_day_15: It downgrades to Free. No card on file, so no charge.

head_to_head.reason: The most honest page of the five, Instacart built in, and a per-person profile that could finally cover Arjun's plain plate

EM.reason: No email gate, visible price, per-person profiles

PTE.reason: DinnerDrop actually plans; Plan to Eat only stores what I already have

OL.reason: One clear price versus metered messages

HF.reason: No dark-pattern pop-up and no eggs forced on me

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: On /start (pricing) FAQ, say that vegetarian can be set to exclude eggs and show a vegetarian sample week; on /signup, make the weekly marketing email a separate opt-in instead of part of the Terms line.
